armorpieces.compat.upgraded: This world was last played on Armor Pieces %s; it is now on %s.
armorpieces.compat.upgraded.before: This world was last played on a version of Armor Pieces older than %s, when the mod shipped its own pieces.
armorpieces.compat.missing: %s piece ids in this world are not installed. Armor wearing them keeps them but cannot show them.
armorpieces.compat.advice: Install the pack that provides them, then open the world again - a pack's pieces are read when a world loads, so /reload alone will not do it. /armorpieces missing lists what is waiting.
commands.armorpieces.missing.none: Nothing is missing - every piece this world has read resolved.
commands.armorpieces.missing.header: %s piece ids could not be resolved:
commands.armorpieces.missing.advice: Install the pack that provides each, then open the world again - a pack's pieces are read when a world loads, so /reload alone will not do it.
commands.armorpieces.missing.caveat: Only counts what has been read so far; a chest that has not loaded cannot be counted yet.
armorpieces.packs.problems: %s problem(s) in the installed Armor Pieces packs. Nothing was refused - the world loaded with what could be read.
armorpieces.packs.advice: /armorpieces packs lists them, with the file and what was done about each. The server log has the same lines.
commands.armorpieces.packs.more: and %s more - the server log has all of them.
commands.armorpieces.packs.advice: skipped: the file could not be read and was left out. worked around: it loaded without the part that was wrong. reported: it loaded and cannot do what it was meant to.
commands.armorpieces.prune.none: Nothing to prune - none of that is wearing an unresolved piece.
commands.armorpieces.prune.dry: Would drop %s sockets from %s items. Nothing changed - add "confirm" to do it, and it cannot be undone.
commands.armorpieces.prune.done: Dropped %s sockets from %s items. This cannot be undone.
commands.armorpieces.upgrade.done: Marked %s loaded chunks to be written back in the new form.
commands.armorpieces.upgrade.caveat: Chunks that are not loaded are untouched, and worn armor needs no help: it is written on logout.
